{
  "name": "vitadeck-workspace",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "prepare": "pnpm --filter @vitadeck/sdk run build",
    "build": "pnpm --filter @vitadeck/sdk build && pnpm --filter \"./examples/*\" build && pnpm --filter @vitadeck/runtime build",
    "tsc": "pnpm --filter @vitadeck/sdk tsc && pnpm --filter @vitadeck/runtime tsc && pnpm --filter \"./examples/*\" tsc && tsc -p scripts",
    "test:cli": "pnpm --filter @vitadeck/sdk test:cli",
    "test:native-globals": "tsx scripts/check-native-globals.ts",
    "bench:report": "tsx scripts/bench-report.ts",
    "lint": "node examples/chat/scripts/ensure-genesys-local.mjs && oxlint",
    "lint:fix": "node examples/chat/scripts/ensure-genesys-local.mjs && oxlint --fix",
    "format": "oxfmt",
    "format:check": "oxfmt --check"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@babel/preset-react": "catalog:",
    "@babel/preset-typescript": "catalog:",
    "@rollup/plugin-babel": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "@types/react": "catalog:",
    "@types/react-reconciler": "catalog:",
    "babel-plugin-react-compiler": "catalog:",
    "oxfmt": "catalog:",
    "oxlint": "catalog:",
    "oxlint-tsgolint": "catalog:",
    "react": "catalog:",
    "react-compiler-runtime": "catalog:",
    "react-reconciler": "catalog:",
    "rolldown": "catalog:",
    "tslib": "catalog:",
    "tsx": "catalog:",
    "typescript": "catalog:"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24.16.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@12.15.0+sha512.b3951d6d6ff4a9f13dc7cf56cd28d2b8eb37dbcc9c68e52e1e1191873ea9f82a017287ab50baadc5ccc494f036c67c0e47eb13608c2fa36f47711b61ea128e61"
}
